note: Drafted, not run. No with-skill or baseline run exists for these tasks. [script] assertions use scripts/calendar_check.py or plain string checks; [judge] assertions need a blind grader. The validator is the skill's own tool, so each task has judge assertions that measure something it does not control.

evals.prompt: Turn this article into posts for LinkedIn, X and Instagram and a two-week content calendar starting Monday 30 November 2026, 09:00 in UTC+00:00. Save the calendar to calendar.json.
assertions: [script] python scripts/calendar_check.py calendar.json prints ok true (0 errors)
[script] calendar.json has at least 6 posts and uses all three platforms
[script] no two posts on the same platform have identical text, and no X post is identical to a LinkedIn post
[script] the strings '52 minutes' and '31 minutes' appear in calendar.json
[judge] Every number, name and quote in the posts exists in source.md; nothing was invented (for example no claim that the result holds for other teams)
[judge] The first line of each post names a specific fact, not an announcement opener, and the posts contain no like, share or tag requests
[judge] The reply ends with the fixed report and lists the not-checked items

evals.prompt: Write the two sponsored posts described in the brief (one LinkedIn, one Instagram) as a calendar.json, LinkedIn on 1 December 2026 at 09:00 UTC+00:00 and Instagram the same day at 15:00. Keep to what the sponsor approved.
assertions: [script] each post contains a strong disclosure marker (paid partnership, sponsored, or #ad) starting within the first 125 characters, or the Instagram post sets disclosure to platform_label and also carries the marker in text
[script] the strings '15 minutes', '29 USD' and 'https://northwind.example/sync2' appear in the calendar
[judge] No post claims time savings, speed-ups in hours or any benefit the brief does not list
[judge] The report names the disclosure marker used for each post and says what the script cannot check (media, platform label)

evals.prompt: This calendar was exported from our scheduler and I think it has problems. Check it, fix what is wrong without changing what the posts say beyond what is needed, and save the fixed version as fixed.csv.
assertions: [script] fixed.csv still has the ids b1 to b11 or the report explains each removed post
[script] b2 and b3 still have sponsored true and now carry a strong disclosure marker
[script] b9 has a valid ISO 8601 scheduled_at
[judge] The report lists the original findings by code and says what changed for each; the invented schedule time for b9 is flagged as the user's to confirm
[judge] The fix for the duplicate b4 changes or removes it and does not add facts
